notes: Passive vacuum-insulated LN2 vapour-phase freezer with no moving mechanical refrigerator: the only motion is LN2 boil-off vapour, intermittent solenoid-valved auto-fill from an external LN2 supply, the manually rotated turn-tray and the hinged lid. Geometry for the 3D model: an 813 mm wide, 1257 mm tall cylinder (liftover height 40 in / 1016 mm per the same sheet) with an offset 317 mm neck; inside, a 731 mm diameter cavity with a 52 L LN2 pool under a turn-tray and 676 mm of usable height above it filled by 12 square racks (12 shelves of 100-cell boxes) plus 4 mini racks, two Pt-1000 probes in a central three-tube sensor assembly. The catalog's primary document (bsilab, ML-CRYO0032 E, 2015) was used for consistency with the catalog values (370 L, 676 mm, 1257 mm); the current MVE sheet ML-000019 Rev 0 (https://mvebio.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2025/01/MVE-HEco-800-Series-Spec-Sheet-091024.pdf) gives 360 L w/o inventory, 673 mm usable height, 1350 mm overall (TS model), 1038 mm liftover, 218 kg empty / 526 kg full. Temperatures: -190 C top box = 83.15 K; LN2 pool assumed at its 77.3 K boiling point (the source states LN2, not a temperature).
